question.text: Which fee is charged on the AVERAGE of opening and closing capital contribution + gross portfolio value?

explanation.text: The Logic: Fixed management fee charged on avg of (capital contribution + gross portfolio value) / 2. The Trap: Performance on profits; exit load on withdrawal; upfront is prohibited. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 10. Manager's Pro-Tip: Document fee-calculation methodology in DD — shows transparency.
